record.question: Who was the first president of Indian National Congress?
record.explanation: Answer D: WC Bannerjee. Womesh Chunder Bonnerjee presided over the first Indian National Congress session in 1885. Reference: https://inc.in/brief-history-of-congress. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
